modalities.evidence: This dataset provides raw EEG from children

output.population: 44 typically developing (TD), 66 autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and 28 sibling of individuals with ASD (SIB) participants, all between 8 and 13 years of age
output.summary: Raw EEG from children recorded across seven paradigms spanning sensory, cognitive control, and motor systems, covering autistic, typically developing, and sibling groups, to map oscillatory function across frequency bands.
